items.title: Kill Insects
items.detail: Giant Teapot or Tanagra Town are reliable spawn locations.

items.title: Build a Decoration in a Shelter
items.detail: Enter your C.A.M.P. shelter and place any decoration from the Decorations category.

items.title: Collect a piece of Bone
items.detail: Human bones are found at Braxson's Quality Medical Supplies in the Mire.

items.title: Eat a Cake, Pie, or Candy
items.detail: Popcorn from a C.A.M.P. Popcorn Machine counts as candy.

items.title: Kill an Enemy with a Shovel during the "Disturbed Grave" Quest
items.detail: Start Disturbed Grave after any public event, then finish enemies with a shovel.

items.title: Sell Swamp Tofu to an NPC vendor
items.detail: Craft Swamp Tofu from Swamp Plant and Wood, then sell to any vendor.

items.title: Sell a Shotgun to an NPC vendor
items.detail: Any shotgun type works; Whitespring Resort has multiple vendors.

items.title: Build Anything in a Workshop or C.A.M.P.
items.detail: Place any small decoration or C.A.M.P. piece at your C.A.M.P. or a claimed workshop.

items.title: Collect Ballistic Ammo
items.detail: Withdraw from stash, craft at Tinker's Workbench, or loot from enemies.

items.title: Craft Bulk Steel
items.detail: Craft at a Tinker's Workbench using Steel scrap and Plastic.

items.title: Craft Bulk Wood
items.detail: Craft at a Tinker's Workbench using Wood scraps and Plastic.

items.title: Cripple a Super Mutant's Limb
items.detail: West Tek Research Center has dense Super Mutant spawns for reliable limb cripples.

items.title: Kill a Mole Miner
items.detail: Blackwater Mine spawns up to 25 Mole Miners inside and around the mine.

items.title: Kill an Enemy with a Sharp or Piercing Weapon during a Head Hunt
items.detail: Start Head Hunt at Highway Town bounty board, then kill marked targets and posse with melee blades.

items.title: Scrap junk to produce Black Titanium
items.detail: Scrap Mole Miner suit scraps and excavator armor mods at any workbench.

items.title: Sell a Weapon to an NPC vendor
items.detail: Sell any weapon to any vendor; Whitespring Resort has multiple options.

events.name: Anniversary Events
events.description: Anniversary celebration event with special activities and rewards.

events.name: Minerva's Big Sale (List 8)
events.description: Limited-time vendor rotation featuring discounted plans and rare items.

events.name: Gold Rush and Double Mutations
events.description: Increased gold rewards and double mutation rates for creatures and rewards.

events.name: Mutated Public Events
events.description: Public events spawn with mutated modifiers and special mutated rewards.

events.name: Double XP Weekend
events.description: Double experience points earned from all activities and combat.

events.name: World Pets Update (Patch 72) / Season 27 Start
events.description: New patch introducing world pets system and beginning of Season 27.

events.name: Treasure Hunter and Double Mutations
events.description: Treasure Hunter event with increased loot drops and double mutations.

events.name: Holiday Scorched
events.description: Holiday-themed Scorched creatures with festive rewards and unique gifts.
